sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Duck Rescue Boat are simple yet addictive. Your goal is to rescue as many ducks as possible from the jaws of hungry octopuses. To do this, you'll need to navigate your rescue boat through the water, collecting ducks and avoiding octopuses along the way. The game is divided into day and night cycles, with each cycle lasting for a set amount of time. During the day, the water is calm and clear, making it easier to navigate and collect ducks. However, as night falls, the water becomes murky and choppy, making it harder to spot ducks and avoid octopuses.

As you collect ducks, your hit points will increase, allowing you to withstand more hits from the octopuses. However, be careful not to get caught, as each hit will reduce your hit points. If you run out of hit points, the game is over, and you'll need to start again from the beginning. To increase your hit points, you'll need to collect life floats, which can be found scattered throughout the water. With each life float you collect, your hit points will increase, allowing you to take more hits from the octopuses.

One of the most challenging aspects of the game is timing. You'll need to time your movements perfectly to avoid getting caught by the octopuses, and to collect ducks before they get away. The game requires a great deal of skill and strategy, and even experienced players will find themselves struggling to rescue ducks at times. However, the game's simplicity and accessibility make it easy to pick up and play, even for players who are new to browser games.
